task.title: CLI uploads fail since 2026-10-29: SDK routes functions to unreachable *.functions.insforge.app
task.body:
## 现象
Dashboard 自 2026-10-29 起显示为 0。`~/.vibeusage/tracker/upload.throttle.json`：最后成功 2026-10-29T18:24Z，之后每次 `Ingest failed: Network request failed: fetch failed`，backoffStep 20。

## 根因
`@insforge/sdk@1.2.2` 的 `functions.invoke` 默认先打 `https://{appKey}.functions.insforge.app/{slug}`（34.120.54.55），仅在 404 时回退到 `${baseUrl}/functions/{slug}`；网络错误不回退。该域名在当前网络 TLS ClientHello 后即被断开（`SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL`），`baseUrl` 网关路径正常。

## 复现
```
curl -sv https://5tmappuk.functions.insforge.app/vibeusage-ingest   # SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL
node --require trace.cjs bin/tracker.js sync                         # fetch failed: Client network socket disconnected before secure TLS connection was established
```
（trace.cjs 包一层 globalThis.fetch 打印 e.cause）

## 修复
`createInsforgeClient` 显式传 `functionsUrl: ${baseUrl}/functions`。dashboard 自行拼 `FUNCTION_PREFIX/slug`，不受影响。
